messages:
sarah-sales: Quick Q — AzureGov POC for HealthCo. They need to sign an orderform + DPA and want e-sign for ~300 named signers (batch). Also strict data residency in Azure Gov. Can we support DocuSign stored in GovCloud or do we need customer-hosted PDF storage? Pricing: they prefer PO + net30.

devon-se: Re: bulk signers — DocuSign has bulk send but storage location depends on account type. Need to confirm DocuSign GovCloud offering. Alternative is pushing signed artifacts to customer blob storage.

maya-security: We can't accept signed proofs stored in commercial tenant. Must be DocuSign GovCloud or customer-hosted storage with CMK/HSM.

ian-legal: If customer-hosted storage, we should add an Appendix to the DPA and a signature-artifact clause in the MSA. Draft snippet below.

ian-legal: ```If Customer elects customer-hosted signature artifact storage, Vendor will provide a signed PDF export endpoint that pushes artifacts to Customer's Azure Blob Storage via secure SAS token or managed identity. Vendor will not retain copies outside Customer's environment and will encrypt artifacts at rest using Customer-managed keys.```

devon-se: Clause looks fine. For the POC, HealthCo wants a fast path — recommend we offer DocuSign GovCloud as temporary option while legal finalizes appendix. I'll ping our DocuSign rep.

sarah-sales: Procurement also asking about PO vs card. They prefer PO + net30. We usually require credit review for PO/net30 for new public sector deals. @sanjay-ops can we fast-track?

sanjay-ops: We can approve PO/net30 with expedited credit check. Need signed orderform, EIN, billing contact, and 3 months of forecasted usage.

maya-security: Also confirm KMS requirements — if sending to customer blob, we must support customer-managed keys and audit log exports. Add to DPA.

ian-legal: I'll prepare MSA + DPA redlines and a short signature matrix. Who will sign on their side?

sarah-sales: Primary signer: Elaine Jones (Head of Procurement) — elaine.jones@healthco.gov. Finance approver: Tom Finch (tom.fin@healthco.gov).

devon-se: I'll draft a minimal orderform/SOW with dual signature blocks and billing fields. Will attach in thread.

sarah-sales: Can we aim to send redlines + orderform by EOD?

ian-legal: I'll aim for EOD. If DocuSign GovCloud confirmation is delayed, we'll send with the customer-storage clause as an explicit option.

DocuSign-bot: docuSign: GovCloud offering confirmed — rep emma.nguyen@docusign.com. :white_check_mark:

sarah-sales: Great — looping in Elaine. I'll follow up for PO details and attach the orderform when ready. :raised_hands:
